onboarding.title: Set up your company

onboarding.incorporationHint: Where the company is (or will be) legally registered.
onboarding.targetMarketsHint: Where you plan to sell. Select one or more.
onboarding.dataRegionHint: Where company data is stored. Recorded now; regional infrastructure rolls out in later phases.
onboarding.suggested: Suggested from the incorporation country — change it if needed.
